thesis: Freedom requires distinct scrutiny of noninterference, real opportunities, nondomination, reflection and revisability.

ideas.statement: A credible unused exit changes a relationship; formal permission, benevolent power and numerous trivial options do not guarantee usable freedom.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Not every natural incapacity is political unfreedom; protective rules can themselves obstruct and commitment can enable or entrap.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Not every natural incapacity is political unfreedom; protective rules can themselves obstruct and commitment can enable or entrap.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read by active LLM; thought experiments, scope and normative distinctions preserved.
